reuse.why: Extends getDateWithSkippedWeekend with a holidays parameter so the move rule stays shared, but the new isNonWorkingDay predicate is kept private and the server handlers re-write it inline.

duplication.why: `d.isWeekend(date) || config.holidays?.includes(dayFromDate(date))` is repeated in getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange as copies of isNonWorkingDay, and the daily-skip-vs-move dispatch is now spelled out in getUpcomingDates as well as getDatesInRange and getNextDate.

placement.why: The holiday-aware move lives in shared/schedules.ts and the type in RecurConfig; the daily skip rule is still decided in each server handler instead of the shared module.

scope.why: Mostly focused, though it also changes getUpcomingDates' daily-weekend behaviour, widens search windows with ad-hoc arithmetic and reformats an unrelated block.

maintainability.why: The non-working-day rule exists in three spellings, schedule-template still does not skip holidays for daily schedules, and window sizes (+14, holidays.length + 2, 366 attempts) are magic numbers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange test weekends/holidays inline instead of using a shared isNonWorkingDay; schedule-template.ts only passes holidays to the move and keeps its own daily handling.

disguised_duplication.where: The inline holiday/weekend checks in app.ts are isNonWorkingDay re-expressed with optional chaining and dayFromDate rather than calling a shared predicate.

one_place.where: The holiday rule is defined in isNonWorkingDay/getDateWithSkippedWeekend in shared/schedules.ts but restated inline twice in server/schedules/app.ts, and server/budget/schedule-template.ts applies only the move half.
